g.text: GCT USB4105 on the top face, mouth at y -31.8 (rear face recessed 0.5)
Pins: Mill-Max 0914 long stroke (overall 8.3, working height 5.82, 60 gf): diameters PROVISIONAL.
Pin bodies stop 0.3 below the plate so that only the plunger passes the steel (no short through the plate).
The modelled plunger ends on the YAML pad plane (z 0.965); the real pad is at 1.13 with the PSA sheet (D10).
At 180° the plungers bear on the base plate and are compressed 2.27 of 2.29 mm stroke: see README, open issues.
